channel.title: VulnRadar — web hacking research signals
channel.description: Web hacking research signals — what is getting louder.

item.title: morgan log forging
item.description: CRLF in a Basic-auth username passes through to the morgan logger — log forging via unsanitized log sink.

item.title: form-data CRLF injection
item.description: CRLF smuggled in a multipart filename becomes a real parsed header part — header injection via form-data.

item.title: WordPress file inclusion (CVE-2026-87902)
item.description: Double-encoded pagename + numeric page_id make get_page_template() include a local PHP file outside the theme directory — realpath() canonicalizes but never proves containment. Conditional RCE via pearcmd.php.

item.title: Khan Academy regex bypass → 1-click ATO (H1 #3723458)
item.description: Login continue validated by KA_DOMAIN_REGEX with unescaped dots in uc.a.run.app — attacker-registered xfarr-6fmjyrz2lq-uc-a-run.app passed, so post-login redirect carried a one-time transfer auth token (/transfer_auth?key=) to the attacker; replayed for full session cookies → 1-click ATO. Lab: mock login + transfer_auth; fix = escape the dots.

item.title: CVE-2026-38529: Krayin CRM BOLA → password reset → ATO
item.description: BOLA in Krayin CRM v2.2.x Settings/UserController.php allows arbitrary password reset → full ATO. CVSS 8.8 High, CWE-269 + CWE-639. PoC and exact fix commit not yet verified — verify before building a lab.

item.title: CRLF-Powered Desync Attacks
item.description: CRLF injection that splits a request at a proxy — desync leading to response queue poisoning.

item.title: The Grafana Ghost
item.description: CSPT via Grafana plugin loader — open redirect to XSS to SSRF. CVE-2025-4123.

item.title: Pi-hole response splitting to session fixation
item.description: CRLF injection in Pi-hole admin — response splitting injects Set-Cookie, leading to session fixation.

item.title: HTTP/1.1 Must Die: The Desync Endgame
item.description: 0.CL desync via Expect: 100-continue — the desync endgame. Servers that assume Content-Length is always present can be desynced.

item.title: Cache Deception + CSPT to Account Takeover
item.description: Chaining client-side path traversal with web cache deception — turning a non-impactful finding into account takeover. From a private bounty audit.

item.title: CVE-2025-53640: Indico BOLA /api/principals → PII exposure
item.description: POST /api/principals with {\"values\":[\"User:<id>\"]} dumped name/email/affiliation for arbitrary user IDs — no authorization on the object reference. Affects Indico 2.2–3.3.6, fixed in 3.3.7. CWE-639; working PoC published.

item.title: Apache Traffic Server chunked smuggling
item.description: Stale CR flag in ATS chunked parser lets smuggled requests slip through to the origin — HTTP request smuggling via parser differentials.

item.title: CSPT2CSRF
item.description: Client-Side Path Traversal turns into CSRF — path confusion makes the browser issue state-changing requests to attacker-influenced paths.

item.title: H1 #2293343: GitLab password reset array pollution → ATO
item.description: Array-polluting user[email] in the password-reset request redirected the reset link to the attacker's address → one-request ATO with no victim interaction. Critical 10.0, $35,000 bounty verified on the report page.

item.title: Canto remote file inclusion (CVE-2023-3452)
item.description: CVE-2023-3452 (CVSS 9.8): unauthenticated wp_abspath parameter passed into require_once() — data:// wrapper gives single-request RCE when allow_url_include=On. RFI is nearly extinct in modern apps; the misconfiguration is the teaching point.

item.title: CVE-2023-28131: Expo OAuth proxy open redirect → ATO
item.description: AuthSession proxy (auth.expo.io) stored attacker-influenced returnUrl in an ru cookie, then redirected the OAuth fragment (code+token) to it — the case-sensitive scheme check was bypassed with mixed-case hTTps://. Full ATO demonstrated on Codecademy. CVSS 9.6, hotfixed within hours. Lab: mock OAuth proxy + IdP, no browser needed; fix = case-insensitive scheme + host allowlist (400).

item.title: Practical Client Side Path Traversal Attacks
item.description: CSPT via stylesheet loader — open redirect to CSS injection. HackerOne #1245165 (Acronis); nominated for PortSwigger Top 10 Web Hacking Techniques 2022.

item.title: PHP filter chains
item.description: Chained php://filter iconv conversions forge executable PHP from a read-only include sink — LFI to RCE with no upload, no log poisoning, no writable file.

item.title: HTTP/2: The Sequel is Always Worse
item.description: H2.CL downgrade desync — HTTP/2 frontend and HTTP/1 backend disagree on where a request ends, enabling request smuggling.

item.title: H1 #1250037: Stripe IDOR email change → ATO
item.description: Account-update endpoint not bound to session identity → attacker changed another user's email, then reset the password → full ATO. Critical, $3,000 bounty verified on the report page.

item.title: GitLab X-HTTP-Method-Override cache poisoning
item.description: Method-override header turns a cacheable GET into an error response that gets cached — cache-poisoned denial of service. $2,500.

item.title: Apache 2.4.49 path traversal (CVE-2021-41773)
item.description: Disclosed H1 report ($4,000 Internet Bug Bounty on the report page): 2.4.49 checked the path for ../ BEFORE decoding %2e to ., so /.%2e/ segments became live traversal after the check. With ScriptAlias /cgi-bin/ + mod_cgi, a GET reads files outside the web root (e.g. /etc/passwd). Fix is config hardening (Require all denied, per the official advisory); 2.4.50's fix was incomplete (CVE-2021-42013), so the upgrade note says >= 2.4.51.

item.title: Shopify X-Forwarded-Host cache poisoning
item.description: Unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host header poisons cached JS assets — defacement and phishing on apps.shopify.com. Bounty raised from $1,300 to $6,300.

item.title: H2C Smuggling
item.description: Smuggling HTTP/2 cleartext inside an HTTP/1.1 Upgrade request — tunneling past front-end protections to reach /admin. Top web hacking technique of 2020.

item.title: PayPal CL.TE desync to stored XSS
item.description: CL.TE request smuggling poisons the cache with attacker content — stored XSS on /signin. $18,900.

item.title: MoPub login open redirect → XSS via javascript: URI (H1 #683298)
item.description: app.mopub.com/login?next= accepted arbitrary destinations including the javascript: scheme; post-login navigation used window.location.href, so the javascript: URI executed as reflected XSS in the victim's session. Bounty paid (amount not shown on the report page). Lab is the first client-side build, verified with a headless-Chromium sidecar that proves JS execution. Fix: allowlist next to relative paths, reject schemes with 400.

item.title: GitLab Maven registry traversal to authorized_keys write (HackerOne #733072)
item.description: Disclosed H1 report ($1,000 bounty): the Grape router validated the pre-decoded URL, so %2e%2e%2f in the Maven file_name segment passed the no-slash regex — a PUT then wrote the attacker's SSH key over authorized_keys. Traversal on a write sink beats traversal on a read sink.

item.title: Cache Poisoned Denial of Service (CPDoS)
item.description: Caching error responses (e.g. 403s) triggered by attacker-controlled headers — denial of service for every user behind the cache.

item.title: Abusing HTTP hop-by-hop request headers
item.description: Connection header tricks proxies into stripping security headers (X-Forwarded-For, Authorization) before the backend — enabling admin bypass and IP spoofing.

item.title: Zip Slip
item.description: Archive entry names (e.g. ../../pwned.txt) written outside the extraction target — arbitrary file write via crafted archives. Concrete instance: CVE-2018-1002203 in unzipper <0.8.13.

item.title: Valve partner CD keys IDOR (H1 #391217)
item.description: GET /partnercdkeys/assignkeys on partner.steamgames.com performed no object-level authorization → any authenticated partner could download all CD keys of any game. Critical, $20,000 bounty ($15k + bonus). Lab: mock partner portal; exploit pulls 5 real keys of game_5002 as another partner (KEY1 validated against independent oracle); fix = is_owner(email, game_id) → 403.

item.title: PayPal IDOR → cross-merchant privilege escalation (H1 #415081)
item.description: POST /businessmanage/users/api/v1/users accepted account_id from the request body without checking that the caller is a member of that account — attacker@evil.com added themselves as admin to victim merchant acct_1002, proven by the (properly authorized) read endpoint listing them. High 7.1, $10,500 bounty. Lab: mock merchant API; fix = is_member(email, account_id) before any mutation (cross-merchant → 403).

item.title: Web Cache Deception Attack
item.description: Path confusion tricks caches into storing private pages under public URLs — leaking account data. PayPal paid $3,000.
